Figure 3:Qualitative comparison on held-out four-reference MultiBanana tasks.
Each reference is outlined in a distinct color, and the phrase in the instruction that refers to it is shown in the same color.
Baseline models often omit, duplicate, or misplace references, or copy and paste them unnaturally, whereas AutoRef-Harness preserves each reference and integrates all four into a coherent scene.
